subject.title: perf(ui): cut forced reflows in Control UI chat render path

question: Should the Control UI startup chunking retune be accepted as part of this render-path performance change after final artifact-budget verification?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the chunk threshold is a release-facing packaging tradeoff rather than a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Accept the coupled change
options.body: Keep the chunking retune with the performance fix if the final build confirms the documented startup budget and preload behavior.

options.title: Split the packaging retune
options.body: Land only the stable-ref and rAF performance changes, then evaluate chunk partitioning independently if maintainers want a narrower performance PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the coupled change
recommendation.body: Keep the chunking retune with the performance fix if the final build confirms the documented startup budget and preload behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored both the render-path optimization and the associated startup-budget adjustment.
